crossRefs.note: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”
“Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes…
When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a…
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s…
Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

translations.web: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
